messages:
Anna: Quick sync — infra capacity shortfall means we have to compress Q2 milestone by 2 weeks. Need to agree on cuts for MVP vs v1 by EOD tom.
Mike: Oof. Is this the GPU pool reschedule or infra patching?
Anna: GPU pods delayed; Dedicated rollout bumped. So we either reduce throughput targets or cut non-blocking features (promptstore, cross-tenant analytics).
Lucy: Recommend trimming promptstore and defer multi-tenant SSO provisioning for v1. Keep core API, streaming, and canary rollout.
Omar: Engineering can shave 1 week if we drop cross-tenant analytics and the per-tenant cost dashboard. But caching improvements are risky to remove.
Raj: Customer asks (ACME + Beta) flag that SSO pilot is high priority. If we cut SSO now we may churn them. Can we do a toggle for SSO behind a feature flag and ship minimal flow? :thinking_face:
Anna: Good point. Proposal: ship SSO minimal flow (login only, no provisioning) as MVP behind flag; push tenant provisioning and admin UIs to v1.
Mike: That seems ok. What about observability? We need token-level cost telemetry — can we scope to sampling instead of full retention?
Omar: Yes. We can sample at 1% and add a cheap aggregator to make rollouts safe.
Lucy: Decision summary: keep core API + streaming + minimal SSO behind flag; cut promptstore, cost dashboard, full provisioning. Sampling for telemetry.
Raj: I'll notify ACME and ask if minimal SSO is acceptable. If not, will escalate.
Anna: Action items: @Omar adjust sprint plan and update burndown; @Mike update release checklist with feature-flag gating; @Raj customer comms; @Lucy update launch criteria doc. Need sign-off from Eng Lead and Sales by 5pm PT.
Omar: I'll drop TKT-4823 (cost dashboard) and reassign resources. ETA EOD for updated plan.
Mike: Will update checklist and add the gate: feature_flag=ssominimal.
Lucy: Adding launch criteria note — "SSO minimal ok with customer opt-in" — pushing to the doc.
Anna: If anyone objects speak now. Otherwise we lock and ship the trimmed MVP, start v1 backlog grooming for the deferred items.
deploy-bot: Note: release window for minor v0.9.1 is open 06/14-06/16 — will reserve slot once features are confirmed.
Anna: Thanks team. I'll post the final cutlist & updated milestone timeline in the docs channel in 30m. :thumbsup:
